description: Front Garden: Trees protected by TPO 472 (2017) G1 (2 x Lime) and G2 (2 x Lime):T1 Lime G2:Existing height: approximately 10 mPollard heads: approximately 5.5 m above ground levelReduction: reduce crown by approximately 4.5 m back to the established pollard headsT2 Lime G2:Existing height: approximately 9 mPollard head: approximately 4.5 m above ground levelReduction: reduce crown by approximately 2.5 m back to the established pollard headT3 Lime G1:Existing height: approximately 11 mPollard heads: approximately 7 m above ground levelReduction: reduce crown by approximately 4 m back to the established pollard headsT4 Lime G1:Existing height: approximately 10 mPollard head: approximately 4 m above ground levelReduction: reduce crown by approximately 4 m back to the established pollard headAll cuts to be made strictly to the established pollard heads only. No new reduction points are authorised.Council Note:A further Lime tree (T5) located within the rear garden is not protected by TPO 472 and is subject only to Conservation Area controls. The Council has raised no objection to the notified works to that tree under CA35, and it does not form part of this TPO decision.
